piece.headline: PARTH PINCHES THE THRONE BY A SINGLE POINT
piece.standfirst: Parth takes the top spot by a single point. 10 managers backed B.Fernandes and cashed in.
piece.big_picture: Parth is top of the league, one point clear of Sukrut, after the week's best score. Sukrut held the lead for a week and now has the leader in his mirror. Atharva Singh sits third. This is a 2-horse race already.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Nihar captained João Pedro, the only manager to do so, instead of B.Fernandes. He got 18 with the armband against 46. That's a 28-point swing. Brave, lonely and expensive.
piece.one_to_watch: Parth leads Sukrut by 1 point. Both sit at the top, and one captain call could settle it. If B.Fernandes fires again, the lead could swap back.

winners.name: Aditya Dalal
winners.verdict: Backed B.Fernandes and climbed 7 places. He also left 16 points on the bench. Imagine if he'd picked those right.

winners.name: Atharva Singh
winners.verdict: Armband on B.Fernandes, no chips, no drama. Atharva Singh did the obvious thing and a podium place followed. Simple works.

losers.name: Pradnyesh
losers.verdict: Haaland on the armband and a week the league's lowest score. The transfers earned +14, so the swaps worked. The rest was just cruel.

losers.name: Sahil Gore
losers.verdict: Captained Haaland, who did score 26 with the armband. The rest of the team didn't turn up. A tough week, and it happens.

losers.name: Pruthviraj
losers.verdict: Haaland armband, 11 points stuck on the bench and a slide to 18th. Those bench points sting more than the captain pick.

ratings.l: Armband, chip and top spot. The only thing missing was bench points.
